_doc: District list of the seamless Kalesh map, as signed (architecture sign-off 2026-11-11; decisions.md 'One seamless open city, no gaps' and 'Architecture record (P0-022)'; MAP_REPAIR.md 'District frames and stitching'; TECH.md 'World layout'). A block is one continuous piece of the map with one frame and one road graph. A district is a focus area inside a block (hand-drawn outline, hero roads, inspector review); everything between focus districts inside a block is real city from the same sources. Placement method: offset = pivot.world + block.factor x geoToWorld(district origin, pivot). The centre block has factor 1.0, so every real place in it sits at its real position relative to India Gate; each far district is its own block at factor 0.5, on its real bearing from India Gate. world = offset + project(lat, lon, district origin) is a translation only: no rotation, scale or mirror, north is -Z. Inside the centre block the production bake projects every tile in the block frame (origin India Gate); a district's own origin and offset give the same point within 0.31 m at 5 km (measured, stitch.json), so the per-district fields stay for the bench tooling (tools/bake/stitch). heightOffset is 0 inside the centre block (one ground model, one height solve); a far block gets one height offset solved over all its joins. 'planned' lists districts that have a block and a placement but no outline or data yet; they move into 'districts' when their outline is drawn. The layout C fields (layout, layoutId, layoutBoxKm, layoutAnchor, draftRect) are kept only because the bench code reads them: 'layout' fixes the world origin (the centre of the layout C map box) until the first bake of the far districts recentres it on the final map box, and its river is a stand-in band at the real Yamuna position near the ITO bridge until the river is baked from OSM water polygons.

method.rule: offset = pivot.world + block.factor * geoToWorld(origin, pivot), tools/geo/projection.ts

gates.note: Checked by the bake (rule R-STITCH) and by tools/bake/stitch/stitch.test.ts: every pair of places in the centre block keeps its real bearing and distance. Pairs of a centre place and a far place may be off by up to about 20 degrees at factor 0.5 (computed, ARCH_OPTIONS.md 'The far south'); far places are exact as seen from India Gate.

method.worldOrigin: the centre of the layout C map box for now (India Gate sits at x 621.6, z 467.2). The first bake that includes a far block moves the world origin to the centre of the final map box (one vector subtracted from every position) so no point is more than about 7 km out (FP1, measured fine at 7 km).

stages._doc: Bake stages (P1-007, TECH.md 'World layout' Stages): `npm run bake -- <stage>`. A stage is one continuous outline inside a block. Every source is fetched once for the outline's box plus the margin (one continuous extract) into dataDir (gitignored) and pinned in data/SOURCES.json. ground: GEDTM30 smoothed over smoothM metres, filtered Copernicus GLO-30 as the fallback; FABDEM is never read.
